jobs_results.title: Consultant Credit Risk Modelling - Madrid
jobs_results.description:
Consultant Credit Risk Modelling - Madrid, Spain - J12764 - Competitive Salary (DOE)

An exciting opportunity to join an independent consulting firm specialising in finance, risk and strategy and with extensive global experience and industry recognition in the financial services. The role is to strengthen their consulting team with an entrepreneurial and dynamic leader to Manager a team. The opportunity will be to help shape a unique and professional environment with fantastic career opportunities.

Expertise required:-

Minimum of 5 years of experience in Credit risk Modelling (IRB) or banking and financial services industry

Ideally, knowledge of operational tasks in terms of validation of credit risk models and regulatory requirements related to IRB approach.

Knowledge of current regulatory requirements relating to ESG regulations and climate risk projects is an advantage.

Quantitative background with strong analytical skills and an interest in quantitative topics

Ability to... work with coding languages ie Excel, Python, SQL

Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team

Ability to work independently and to quickly familiarise with new topics, understand, structure and derive innovative solutions

Fluent in English and Spanish (incl. the ability to write professional reports) openess to travel in Europe

If this sounds like the role for you then please apply today!

Alternatively, you can refer a friend or colleague by taking part in our fantastic referral schemes! If you have a friend or colleague who would be interested in this role, please refer them to us. For each relevant candidate that you introduce to us (there is no limit) and we place, you will be entitled to our general gift/voucher scheme.

Datatech is one of the UK’s leading recruitment agencies in the field of analytics and host of the critically acclaimed event, Women in Data. For more information, visit our website: www.datatech.org.uk

jobs_results.title: SENIOR TABLEAU/PBI DATA ANALYTICS CONSULTANT- Madrid
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

A Data Analytics consultant has a well-defined job description.

You will become the best consultant and develop skills to help our customers introduce and use the best Data Analytics tools on the market in their company.

There is no limit to the level of product knowledge we expect you to achieve

You will advise clients on the technologies to use, provide training and advice on all

functionalities and in some cases, you may be asked to suggest or build useful data

sources for analysis

Your profile

Required skills:
• Degree in technical disciplines, economics, management, design
• Previous experience as a consultant or as data analyst or report specialist
• Previous experience in managing people and/or managing projects independently
• Technical or Design background
• At least 3 years of experience using Tableau Desktop/Server, Microsoft Power BI, Alteryx Designer/Server
• Good knowledge of the English language
• Availability to travel and if necessary also for... short engagements abroad.

Preferred requirements (will be an asset)
• Knowledge of SQL language and ability to write queries that produce datasets required for analysis or reporting/data analysis tools.
• Knowledge of Python and R languages
• Knowledge of Linux and AWS systems (not a prerequisite, but preferred).
• Knowledge of Snowflake (not a prerequisite, but preferred).

About you
• Passionate. We don't expect you to know EVERYTHING but that you are ready and willing to learn. Autonomous and self-starter but a team player. Able to work independently but integrate with a team of product enthusiasts both in Italy and Europe
• Expert. You should at least have participated in some project no matter if it is via SAP, Hadoop, Salesforce, or Microsoft SQL Server, we are curious to know.
• Vocal. Very often you will be at a client's site but when you are not, both we and our clients would like to know what you think through active participation in blogs, social but also public events, and workshops
• Interested. Data should be an interest in general, discovering new insights and looking forward to analyzing and visualizing them.
• Leadership-oriented: you will have the opportunity to manage a small team and/or manage projects independently by coordinating people

What we expect:
• Creation and development of Dashboards for our customers
• Preparation and delivery of training courses, workshops, webinars
• Technical assistance and customer support
• Preparation, extraction, and cleaning of databases by creating processes with Alteryx
• Support for pre-sales and marketing activities

You will work in an international group with some of the world's best users and trainers in Tableau and Alteryx products and more generally in the world of data analytics and data visualization.

Exposure to various sectors and industries

Cross-training in various areas using the entire European team
